parameters.name: DeviceName
parameters.description:
The name of the device that you want to delete.

><notice> If you specify this parameter, you must also specify **ProductKey**.
></notice>

parameters.name: IotId
parameters.description:
The ID of the device that you want to delete.

><notice> **IotId** is a globally unique identifier of the device and corresponds to a combination of **ProductKey** and **DeviceName**. If you specify this parameter, you do not need to specify **ProductKey** or **DeviceName**. If you specify **IotId** together with **ProductKey** and **DeviceName**, **IotId** takes precedence.
></notice>

parameters.name: IotInstanceId
parameters.description:
The instance ID. On the **Overview** page in the IoT Platform console, view the **ID** of the current instance.

><notice>
- If this value exists, you must specify this parameter. Otherwise, the call fails.
- If the **Overview** page or the **ID** value is not available, you do not need to specify this parameter.

></notice>

For more information about instances, see [Overview](~~356505~~).

parameters.name: ProductKey
parameters.description:
The **ProductKey** of the product to which the device that you want to delete belongs.

><notice> If you specify this parameter, you must also specify **DeviceName**.
></notice>
